tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Rafał Doniec's services (AI automation, AI assistants, agent-ready companies, apps, strategy, prototypes, training, mentoring) with net price ranges in PLN and typical duration.

tools.name: match_service
tools.description: Reads a client's need in their own words and suggests the service and the answers it mentions. Rules in code, no language model; check the result with the client.

tools.name: get_quote_questions
tools.description: The five questions of a service with their option ids, as the quote assistant on the site asks them. q1–q3 set the price; when and budget set the start and the follow-up.

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Net price range in PLN, monthly upkeep, duration and what the price is made of, for a service and its answers, computed from the price list in code (the same as the quote assistant on the site). With all five answers it also returns the draft offer. Hosts with MCP Apps show the estimate as an offer

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Starts a quote request for the client: e-mails a 6-digit code to the client's address and returns a token. Ask the client for the code, then call confirm_quote with the same details. Nothing reaches Rafał until the code is confirmed.

tools.name: confirm_quote
tools.description: Confirms the quote request with the 6-digit code the client received. Rafał gets the request and the client gets a copy of the draft offer by e-mail. One request per address a day.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Posts of Rafał Doniec's blog about AI in companies, newest first.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Rafał Doniec: e-mail, booking a call, LinkedIn, and the company details.
